newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Feed supply weighs on prices.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Feed supply weighs on prices.

text.p: Cash bids for millfeeds continued to slide Friday in reaction to ample feed supplies in most areas of the country, dealers said.
"We went from a short grain supply to a huge grain supply," said a Texas dealer, who reported wheat and pastures have lessened the demand for millfeeds.
In the Southeast, hominy, soybean hulls and corn gluten feed were in ample supply and competively priced with millfeeds, dealers there said.
Buffalo sources said lush pastures and alfalfa hay were decreasing millfeed use.
Low milk prices also had dairy farmers in the Northeast trying to minimize feed costs by cutting back on supplemental feeding and relying more on pastures and hay.
Kansas sources reported excellent wheat yields from early harvested fields, which should provide ample wheat for feeding.
